Fluidyne V2020 Double Vane Pumps, 19.5 cm³/rev, Left-Hand (CCW). 88 part numbers, 19.5 cm³/rev displacement, up to 2,500 psi. Each size shows the Vickers part number it replaces, as the manufacturer publishes it.

Quote the Fluidyne part number or the Vickers number it replaces. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

Fluidyne V2010 Double Vane Pumps, 19.5 cm³/rev, Left-Hand (CCW). 114 part numbers, 19.5 cm³/rev displacement, up to 2,500 psi. Each size shows the Vickers part number it replaces, as the manufacturer publishes it.

  • Displacement: 19.5 cm³/rev
  • Max pressure: up to 2,500 psi
  • Equivalents: Vickers part numbers listed against each size

Vane pump flow is displacement × speed (in³/rev × rpm ÷ 231 = US gpm). Rotation is viewed from the shaft end; match it, the shaft and the port sizes to the pump you are replacing.

How to order

Quote the Fluidyne part number or the Vickers number it replaces. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.
